task_message:
Case M35: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 220x220x320 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Done. 

**Summary of the M35 segmentation:**

- **Lesion found:** a large, well-circumscribed, T2-hyperintense lobulated mass in the anterior soft tissues of the limb, spanning ~123 slices axially (≈ 6 × 6.5 × 12 cm), with internal septation/heterogeneity typical of a myxoid soft-tissue tumor.
- **Method:** located the mass on axial contact sheets, obtained `edges` marks on the axial slice through its largest cross-section (k=120) and used a 13-vertex **lasso** to outline it in one model prompt.
- **Verification:** checked the mask at both tapering ends (ax 65–85, 160–186), on coronal/sagittal reformats, and with `seg_candidates` (no missed tissue proposed). A `seg_refine` pass smoothed the boundary (206.5 → 214.0 mL) without changing the lesion extent meaningfully.
- **Final review:** all three inside-slices per plane follow the lesion edge; the one-just-past-each-end panels (ax 51/203, cor 80/163, sag 97/174) show no residual lesion tissue, confirming the extent is correct.

Final mask: 214.0 mL, essentially a single component (99.9%), saved with **high** confidence.
